card.name: Small words in old historical prose
card.fires_on: Common small words such as the, its, must or a inside long sentences of 19th-century history, geography and political writing. It does not depend on the word itself, but on the formal archaic prose around it.

modes.label: Articles and pronouns in geography
modes.description: The word the or its inside a description of land, valleys or regions.
modes.example: Five lakes are spread over the Valley, occupying one tenth of<< its>> surface.

modes.label: Adverbs and verbs in political argument
modes.description: A linking word such as must, necessarily or alone in an old-style argument about war or labour.
modes.example: I thought what a fearful responsibility General Taylor<< must>> feel, commanding such a host and so
